# Ideafridge

> Short-form content for B2B sales teams.

Ideafridge turns relevant market developments and a company's expertise into short videos and posts its sales team can share with buyers.

Canonical: https://ideafridge.com/
Full profile: https://ideafridge.com/llms-full.txt
Privacy: https://ideafridge.com/privacy.html
Terms: https://ideafridge.com/terms.html

## Audience
Cybersecurity, AI, and B2B SaaS companies with sales teams and defined buyers.

## Service
Research, story development, scripts, short-form video production, social posts, and outreach copy. Scope and commercial terms are agreed before purchase.

## Responsibilities
Ideafridge handles research, writing, and production. The client owns approval, sharing, and buyer follow-up.

## Evidence
Website SVG illustrations explain the service and are not client results. Ideafridge does not guarantee pipeline, rankings, or AI citations.

## Contact
https://ideafridge.com/#connect

## Typical uses
- Employee social posts that explain relevant buyer questions.
- Prospecting messages tied to a market development.
- Follow-up content that clarifies a decision or trade-off.
- Adaptation of existing expertise and approved source material.

## Evaluation
The engagement can be evaluated through usage and client-reported buyer responses without direct CRM access. Commercial outcomes require additional client evidence and should not be inferred from views alone.

## Starting an engagement
Begin with an audience and use-case discussion. A sample may help assess fit before a paid engagement. Agree price, duration, scope, responsibilities, and success criteria in writing.
